title: Derp Universe — Game Definition Schemas
description: JSON schema documentation for all game definition data files loaded by the definitions seed.

SynergySelector.description: Filters which entities a SynergyRule applies to. All fields are optional; an empty object {} matches any entity.

entityTypes.description: Match entities whose entityType is in this list.

speciesIds.description: Match entities whose speciesId (entityDefinitionId) is in this list.

collections.description: Match entities whose collectionId (NftCollectionDef.id) is in this list.

traitsAny.description: Match entities that have at least one of these archetype values in any trait slot. Case-insensitive.

traitsAll.description: Match entities that have ALL of these archetype values (each in any slot). Case-insensitive.

minTraitCount.description: Minimum number of distinct non-null trait values the entity must have.

rarities.description: Match entities whose rarity is in this list (e.g. 'common', 'rare', 'legendary').

regions.description: Match entities currently stationed in one of these regionIds.

locationTypes.description: Match entities currently in a location of one of these types.

buildingTagsAny.description: Match entities at a location that has at least one of these building tags.

missionTagsAny.description: Match entities with at least one of these mission tags.

factions.description: Match entities whose traits.faction value is in this list. Case-insensitive.

SynergyContext.description: Constrains which activity contexts trigger a SynergyRule. All fields are optional; an empty object {} matches any context.

activityTypes.description: Match activities whose activityType is in this list (e.g. 'mission', 'crafting', 'outpost').

missionTypes.description: Match missions whose missionType is in this list (e.g. 'quick', 'boss', 'seasonal').

missionTagsAny.description: Match activities tagged with at least one of these mission tags.

regionIds.description: Match activities occurring in one of these regions.

seasonIds.description: Match activities occurring during one of these seasons.

requiresTeamSizeMin.description: Rule only fires when the team has at least this many entities.

requiresTeamSizeMax.description: Rule only fires when the team has at most this many entities.

SynergyEffect.description: A single effect emitted by a SynergyRule when it fires.

operation.description: How the value is applied. flat_add: absolute addition. percent_add: percentage addition (e.g. -10 = -10%). multiplier: multiplicative (compound exponent with applications). flat_seconds: absolute seconds added to duration.

value.description: Numeric value for the operation. Negative = penalty/reduction.

stat.description: Stat key for stat_modifier (e.g. ATK, DEF, SPD, FOC, VIT, LCK).

immuneTo.description: Named debuff or effect type for immunity.

SynergyRule.description: A data-driven synergy rule that awards bonuses or penalties based on entity trait combinations and activity context.

effects.description: Effects emitted when the rule fires.

stackGroup.description: Optional group name for cross-rule stacking logic.

stackMode.description: additive: each pair fires independently. unique: fires once if any pair matches. best_only: only the highest-positive-value rule in the stackGroup fires. highest_abs_only: only the highest |value| rule fires.

maxApplications.description: Max times this rule fires per resolver call.

startsAt.description: ISO datetime — rule only fires after this time.

endsAt.description: ISO datetime — rule stops firing after this time.

synergy-rules.json.description: Seed file for SynergyRule records. Loaded by definitions.seed.ts and upserted with upsertManyForce on every boot.
